## Code Review

This pull request updates the FigureAsset runtime readiness gate to consume the full 858 production index and introduces a new production readiness closeout report in both JSON and Markdown formats. The build script and its corresponding tests have been expanded to calculate final terminal counts, construct a parent closeout checklist, and map issues to PRs. A critical review comment identifies a potential double-counting bug in the visualTerminalCountConservation validator calculation where a production-ready row blocked by layout issues could be counted twice, suggesting a transition to summing mutually exclusive terminal states instead.

### scripts/method-map/build-figureasset-runtime-readiness-gate.mjs (962-966)

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

There is a potential double-counting bug in the `visualTerminalCountConservation` calculation. If a production-ready row is blocked from display due to layout issues (e.g., `layout_fragment_missing_anti_bypass_fields`) but has rights allowed, its `runtime_terminal_state` will be `'other_terminal'`. In this case, the row is counted in both `production_ready` and `other_terminal`, leading to double-counting in `visualTerminalCountConservation` and causing the validator check `final_visual_terminal_counts_conserve_858_rows` to fail.

To fix this, use `student_display_eligible + rights_blocked_production_ready` instead of `production_ready` to ensure that all mutually exclusive terminal states are correctly summed without double-counting.

```suggestion
  const visualTerminalCountConservation = visualFinalCounts.student_display_eligible
    + visualFinalCounts.rights_blocked_production_ready
    + visualFinalCounts.qa_review
    + visualFinalCounts.manual_crop
    + visualFinalCounts.source_missing
    + visualFinalCounts.other_terminal;
```

</details>
